groups.title: Structured-output contract
groups.expected: Return exactly an object with boolean ok=true under the supplied JSON schema.
groups.developer_impact: Typed consumers must distinguish a boolean from text or numeric lookalikes.
groups.recommendation_to_evaluate: Clarify model-specific schema support and unsupported-keyword errors; if supported, rerun this exact schema probe.
groups.acceptance_test: Rerun the structured_json probe with the same model and parameters; publish every attempt and confirm its contract. Do not use one passing trial as a reliability guarantee.

groups.title: Tool-call identity and arguments
groups.expected: Return one completed report tool call with a non-empty ID and JSON boolean ok=true.
groups.developer_impact: Agent tools need stable call identifiers and valid arguments to associate results.
groups.recommendation_to_evaluate: Document forced-tool-choice behavior for the exact model and provide a round-trip example with matching tool results.
groups.acceptance_test: Rerun the tool_call probe with the same model and parameters; publish every attempt and confirm its contract. Do not use one passing trial as a reliability guarantee.

groups.title: Streaming reconstruction
groups.expected: Complete SSE output with terminal markers reconstructs the requested JSON object.
groups.developer_impact: Truncation or lost deltas can corrupt typed agent state.
groups.recommendation_to_evaluate: Provide a tested streaming example including finish_reason, DONE and usage-only chunks; clarify truncation handling.
groups.acceptance_test: Rerun the streaming probe with the same model and parameters; publish every attempt and confirm its contract. Do not use one passing trial as a reliability guarantee.

groups.title: Invalid-model error contract
groups.expected: An intentionally nonexistent model returns a structured model-specific 400/404/422 error.
groups.developer_impact: Developers need actionable configuration errors rather than retrying invalid model IDs.
groups.recommendation_to_evaluate: Include a stable error code, requested model identifier and a link to model discovery in unsupported-model errors.
groups.acceptance_test: Rerun the invalid_model_error probe with the same model and parameters; publish every attempt and confirm its contract. Do not use one passing trial as a reliability guarantee.

caveats: Producer-declared HTTP provenance is not independently authenticated by this renderer.
A contract failure is not automatically a platform bug: inspect model support, request validity, account limits and harness behavior.
Repeated same-model trials can be correlated; Wilson intervals are descriptive under independent-binomial assumptions, not a population reliability guarantee.
No observed HTTP response means no positive or negative platform claim.
Exact Devpost field and character limit remain unverified.
